S. I. REGISTRY

Station /
Date December 29. 19 37

Subject Communication dated 18-12-37 from the Netherlands Consulate-
General concerning G.P. Vokhmianin.

Made by D.S.I. Irokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford. D. I.

Gabriel Prokopievich VOKHMIANIN, Russian, was born on
March 15, 1901 in Viatka Province, Russia. According to his own
statement, he left the U.S.S.R. for China in March, 1930 and sub-
sequently resided in Harbin where he was employed as a salesman
in a Chinese firm for about 15 months. He then proceeded to Shang-
hai arriving in this city in June, 1931. When registering at the
Russian Emigrants' Committee, 118/1 Moulmein Road he produced pas-
port No 3169 issued by the Harbin police on 25-2-31.

In Shanghai Vokhmianin has been engaged in commercial
business selling fish, caviar etc. In this connection he is known
to have had business relations with the local branch of the Cen-
trosojus ( England) Ltd, from which firm he bought goods imported
from the U.S.S.R. It is reported that in 1934 these connections
were broken off following a civil suit Vokhmianin brought at the
British Court in Shanghai against the Centrosojus.

He frequently visited Dairen and Japan in connection
with his business, and is reported to have certain independent
means.

In December, 1932 he was divorced from his wife nee
Mogarovsky.

While in Shanghai he did not come to the notice of the
Municipal Police in connection with any activities of an undesi-
rable character.

（批：2 B.R. 29/2）

A. Prokopiew
D. S. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).

日期 1937年12月29日

事由：荷兰总领事馆于1937年12月18日就G.P. Vokhmianin一事发出的公函。

由侦探长Irokofiev撰写。由侦探长C. Crawford转呈。

Gabriel Prokopievich VOKHMIANIN，俄国人，1901年3月15日出生于俄罗斯维亚特卡省（Viatka Province）。据其自述，他于1930年3月离开苏联前往中国，随后居住在哈尔滨，在一家中国商号担任推销员约15个月。此后他前往上海，于1931年6月抵达本市。在慕尔鸣路（Moulmein Road）118/1号的俄国侨民委员会登记时，他出示了由哈尔滨警方于1931年2月25日签发的第3169号护照。

在上海期间，Vokhmianin从事商业活动，销售鱼类、鱼子酱等。在此方面，据悉他与英商“中央消费合作总社有限公司”（Centrosojus (England) Ltd）本地分行有业务往来，他从该公司购买从苏联进口的货物。据报道，1934年，因Vokhmianin在上海英国法院对中央消费合作总社提起民事诉讼，这些联系随之中断。

因业务关系，他经常前往大连和日本，据悉他拥有一定的独立资产。

1932年12月，他与原姓Mogarovsky的妻子离婚。

在上海期间，他未因任何不良性质的活动引起工部局警务处的注意。

（批注：2 B.R. 29/2）

A. Prokopiew
侦探长

副督察长（特别科）。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 4205.

SHANGHAI, 18th December 1937.

S. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 8265
30 12 37

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Gabriel Prokopievich
Vokhmianin has applied to this Consulate for a visé for ad-
mission into Iran.

Vokhmianin is in possession of a valid passport issued
by the Bureau of Public Safety on April 5, 1937 under No. 8021/
356792. According to his passport he is born at Vyatka in 1901.
He resides at 306 Rue Card. Mercier, Apartment 3 and he
intends to visit Iran for about two months for business pur-
poses.

His passport has been visaed by the British Consulate-
General at Shanghai for travelling to Hong Kong on December
10, 1937 and by the American Consulate at Dairen on Septem-
ber 14, 1937.

I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let me
know, if possible, whether anything is known against this
person from a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE 21 DEC. 1937〕

Acting Consul-General
temporarily in charge of Iranian Interests.

The Deputy Commissioner
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

D. S. J. Godefroi.

上海，1937年12月18日。

S. 登记处
编号 S. B. D. 8265
30 12 37

先生：

谨此通知阁下，Gabriel Prokopievich Vokhmianin已向本领事馆申请入境伊朗的签证。

Vokhmianin持有由公共安全局（Bureau of Public Safety）于1937年4月5日签发的有效护照，号码为8021/356792。根据其护照记载，他于1901年出生于维亚特卡（Vyatka）。他现居住于梅神父路（Rue Card. Mercier）306号3室，拟因公务前往伊朗逗留约两个月。

他的护照已于1937年12月10日由英国驻上海总领事馆签注前往香港的签证，并于1937年9月14日由美国驻大连领事馆签注签证。

如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度是否掌握对此人不利的情况，本人将不胜感激。

顺致
崇高敬意

〔印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 1937年12月21日〕

代理总领事
暂代伊朗利益事务负责人。

致：

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别科副督察长，
